normal.title: Normal Dry-Weather Baseline
assumptions: Constant dry-weather inflow of 0.005 CMS (5 L/s) at upstream junction J1.
All three circular conduits (C1, C2, C3) have 0.30 m diameter, 100 m length, n=0.013, 1% slope.
All junctions (J1, J2, J3) have 2.0 m maximum depth; free outfall at O1.

partial_blockage.title: Partial Blockage in Conduit C2 (0.30 m -> 0.15 m)
modifications: Conduit 2 circular diameter reduced from 0.30 m to 0.15 m.
assumptions: Represents sediment/grease accumulation constricting effective flow area in Conduit 2 (J2->J3).
Inflow remains constant at 0.005 CMS at J1.

severe_blockage.title: Severe Blockage in Conduit C2 (0.30 m -> 0.06 m)
modifications: Conduit 2 circular diameter reduced from 0.30 m to 0.06 m.
Conduit 2 Manning roughness increased from 0.013 to 0.025 to reflect debris drag.
assumptions: Models near-complete obstruction (debris/root intrusion) in C2 while 0.005 CMS continues entering J1.
Original network elevations, inflow, and simulation window (6 hours) remain unchanged.

heavy_rainfall.title: Heavy Rainfall Storm Runoff & Surcharge
modifications: Added urban impervious catchments S1 (4.5 ha -> J1) and S2 (4.5 ha -> J2) with peak 60 mm/hr rainfall.
assumptions: Models stormwater inflow/infiltration entering a combined or storm-impacted sewer.
Original conduits, slopes, elevations, and 0.005 CMS dry-weather baseflow at J1 are preserved.

sudden_inflow.title: Sudden Abnormal Discharge / Shock Inflow at J2
modifications: Added [INFLOWS] time-series discharge SURGE_TS at J2 peaking at 0.14 CMS (140 L/s) from 01:00 to 02:30.
assumptions: Models sudden unauthorized industrial/tanker discharge, main break intrusion, or upstream pump dump at J2.
Baseline 0.005 CMS inflow at J1 and all pipe geometries are unchanged.

downstream_siltation.title: Downstream Obstruction / Siltation in Conduit C3
modifications: Conduit 3 circular diameter reduced from 0.30 m to 0.08 m.
Conduit 3 Manning roughness increased from 0.013 to 0.030.
assumptions: Models downstream outfall constriction or heavy sediment buildup in C3 causing backwater at J3.
Dry-weather inflow at J1 remains 0.005 CMS.
